items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Evelyn Nesbeth, you don't remember her because she was connected with Harry K. Thaw way back there, in that big scandal that time.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah. They made records. Of course, I'm in New York, but I got their records. I like their style, Dixieland.

So I -- of course, I wasn't exactly stealing. But I liked the style they played. And I played that style down at Small's and they all went crazy about it. They went crazy about it. Strictly Dixieland. Yeah, because I'm not that type of player. Now, you know who stole from me? Harry James. He used to come up there and listen to me playing and all like that. I played on that style. Establish the tune and all like that, and then I'd improvise on my trumpet. As I felt, and that's the way he played.
